<!-- Mission and place, or menu/movie. Can you make it happen again? -->

- Vita model (Vita 1000 / 2000 / PS TV):
- Firmware (Settings > System > System Information):

- Version of the port (for example 1.0):
- Settings you changed from the defaults (HD textures, anti-aliasing, pixel lighting, ...):
- 500 MHz profile installed? yes / no

**The log**
<!-- Leave the game with START + SELECT + L + R, then attach ux0:data/infected/log.txt.
     It has no personal data: settings, timings and the game's messages. If the game crashed, add log_sync=1 to
     ux0:data/infected/config.txt, make it happen again, and attach that log. -->

Please don't attach your ISO, saves or anything made from the game.
